limitations: No engine/build/profiler run; existing replay files read unchanged.

All candidate magic locations require full structural/count/length/budget validation and exact EOF; exactlyonevalidtail required. Prefix game/save/order stream not fully decoded, so this is not complete replay load/acceptance validation.
Byte-preserving metadata triples are ordered and duplicates retained. Comparisons use player and vector position; metadata changes are separated from value changes.
Only captured changed rows are retained: row transitions compare the last retained row per player, not every game tick. Truncation means later telemetry is absent even if the game continues.

Logical16MiB accounting and wirebytes are not live heap/RSS. Unique repeated bytes quantify representation redundancy but imply no resident-memory or CPU savings; dictionaries/deltas have additional overhead.

Interning or compact/delta storage must reconstruct exact metadata/value/updated/order/duplicates/availability/frame history and preserve existing AIT1 persistence payload, not merely rendered values. Reserve prototype tests remain pending.
